Description.Name: Training Module 3
Description.Details: With a training space packed with Battle Pods, lances can compete against each other, and that inevitably means teams, logos and pennants. Each MechWarrior and vehicle crew with less than 30,000 total experience gains 50 experience points a day.

AssignedCastDescription: I've got a design for my simulator team's insignia ready to go, Commander. We're gonna get shirts made—and maybe even warm-up jackets.
